title: Rethinking the funnel: where mobile gaming really fits in the marketing mix
summary: Discover why industry leaders are rethinking the marketing funnel. Learn how mobile gaming ads deliver full-funnel results from brand awareness to conversion.
body_markdown:
**What this means for programmatic teams:** don't let legacy classification determine your strategy. Mobile gaming is a full-funnel channel, and the teams planning it that way are getting more out of it.


As mobile gaming continues to move further up the funnel, the conversation extends beyond planning to trust. Greater transparency into the advertising experience—through initiatives like[Unity Core Standards](https://unity.com/blog/mobile-game-advertising-transparency-unity-core-standards) —helps give marketers more confidence in where and how their brands appear, supporting the channel's continued evolution.
